<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Swift Prey](/Classes.aspx?ID=9)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 166

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

You size up your prey with only a glance. You can use Hunt Prey as a free action if it’s your first action of your turn.
name: Swift Prey
